name: backend-observability
title: Backend-observability-and-error-contracts
description: Incremental backend logging and error-contract improvements; Railway stdout capture, no extra storage.
creator: codex
notes: User approved module-by-module commits, compatibility-first migration and disabled-by-default direct log alerts. No push.

measurement.source: Existing Grafana/Faro and Sentry data grouped by release/route/platform; no visible baseline samples yet.
measurement.window: Compare 24 hours before and after deployment; extend when N<100, separately for Android and iOS.

mobile_performance.notes: Null means unmeasured. Target ordinary pages/APIs at 2000ms and no more than 5 percent P95 regression. Measure SSE and long jobs separately. Real production verification remains required.

scope: Backend HTTP, providers, payment, scheduled jobs and logging planning/CI tools
integration_points: Reuse platform/observability, safe Pino output, clientFetch and runObservedJob; no additional storage
failure_paths: HTTP 401/403/409/429/5xx and disconnect; provider timeout; missing-event errors; concurrent jobs; disabled/failed notification
logging_integration.correlation: Reuse request ALS and isolated job roots; transport child spans; one terminal event per operation.
logging_integration.redaction: Safe fields and child bindings only; bounded DB/network error codes and cause; omit raw error messages, personal data, bodies, URLs and credentials.
logging_integration.alerting: LOG_ALERTING_ENABLED remains off by default; on uses existing direct bounded rules with internal/public codes, no persistence or new deployment resources.
verification: Backend full credential-free tests plus logger/http/alert/free-zone regression tests
Backend typecheck, ESLint, complexity and AST logging guard
Python planning gate tests including pending/missing declaration, state isolation and CI selection
After release inspect Railway correlation and actual notifications; record real Android/iOS/API P95 without inventing samples
